API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingExtranet Resource Update Extranet
Extranet Resource Update Extranet
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/extranet

Updates an extranet based on the specified ID

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the extranet

id
int32

The unique identifier for the extranet

name
string

The name of the extranet

description
string

The description of the extranet

extranetDNSList
object[]
extranetIpPoolList

Information about the traffic selectors specified for the extranet. Type: Array

createdAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was created

modifiedAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was last modified

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for the extranet

name
string

The name of the extranet

description
string

The description of the extranet

extranetDNSList
object[]
extranetIpPoolList

Information about the traffic selectors specified for the extranet. Type: Array

createdAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was created

modifiedAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was last modified
